package.name: generated_objects_eval
package.description: Downstream evaluation of objects produced by the 3d_generator: MoveIt 2 motion-planning success rate, Gazebo dynamic-stability rate, and pick-and-place success on a Franka Panda. Used to produce the independent downstream metrics requested by ICARM 2026 reviewers (R1, R2-Q1/Q2/Q3, AE).
